{
  "$schema": "../../.claude-plugin/schemas/plugin.schema.json",
  "name": "vector-memory",
  "version": "3.2.0",
  "description": "RAG-powered session memory with waypoints for Claude Code",
  "author": {
    "name": "AerionDyseti",
    "url": "https://github.com/AerionDyseti"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/aeriondyseti/vector-memory-mcp",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "memory",
    "rag",
    "waypoints",
    "session-persistence",
    "vector-search"
  ],
  "mcpServers": "./.mcp.json",
  "hooks": "./hooks/hooks.json",
  "skills": "./skills/",
  "userConfig": {
    "compactCheckpoint": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Waypoint at compaction",
      "description": "At compaction: ask each time whether to clear to a waypoint instead, always save a waypoint (and memories) and compact, or never.",
      "options": [
        "ask",
        "always",
        "never"
      ],
      "default": "ask"
    },
    "exitCheckpoint": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Waypoint before /clear and /exit",
      "description": "Save a waypoint (and memories) before /clear and /exit: ask each time, always save, or never.",
      "options": [
        "ask",
        "always",
        "never"
      ],
      "default": "ask"
    },
    "loadCheckpoint": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Load waypoint at start and after /clear",
      "description": "Load the latest waypoint into a new session: ask each time, always load, or never.",
      "options": [
        "ask",
        "always",
        "never"
      ],
      "default": "ask"
    },
    "fileMemorySync": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sync file-based memories",
      "description": "When Claude writes or edits a file-based memory (projects/<project>/memory/*.md), also store it as a vector memory.",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "on"
    }
  }
}
